transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
JPMorgan's CEO warns that artificial intelligence cyber risks went up 10-fold after Anthropic's Mythos, according to The Financial Express, Confirmed.
Minnesota's artificial intelligence nudification law is on pause after a federal appeals court decision, per Lakeland PBS, Reported.
Mistral launches a new artificial intelligence model it says outperforms some Chinese rivals, with public release on Oct 27, according to AsiaOne, Reported.
ServiceNow launches artificial intelligence workflow tools in India to scale enterprise artificial intelligence and boost developer capabilities, per techgig, Confirmed.
Nvidia boosts buybacks and launches an artificial intelligence safety platform amid lender scrutiny, according to AD HOC NEWS, Reported.
